_description: Complete definitions of all minute-derived features. Each entry documents the exact formula used to compute the feature from raw minute bar data (open, high, low, close, volume, amount, num_trades, minute).

vwap_divergence_close.description: How far the closing price is from the cumulative volume-weighted average price. Positive = close above fair value, negative = below.
vwap_divergence_close.derivation: VWAP_eod = Σ(amount) / Σ(volume) over all bars. close_eod = last bar's close.

vwap_divergence_max.formula: max(|(close_i − VWAP_cum_i) / VWAP_cum_i|) over all bars i
vwap_divergence_max.description: Maximum absolute deviation from cumulative VWAP during the day. Measures worst execution relative to fair value.
vwap_divergence_max.derivation: VWAP_cum_i = cumulative sum(amount) / cumulative sum(volume) up to bar i.

vwap_divergence_30m.description: EOD close vs VWAP after first 30 minutes of trading. Large divergence means price moved significantly after the opening auction settled.
vwap_divergence_30m.derivation: VWAP_30m = VWAP_cum at bar where minute <= 100000.

vwap_slope.description: Normalized linear slope of VWAP over the day. Positive = VWAP rising (buying pressure), negative = falling.
vwap_slope.derivation: Linear regression y = ax + b of VWAP_cum vs bar index. Slope a divided by mean VWAP_cum for normalization.

vwap_volume_share_last_hour.description: Fraction of day's total volume traded in the last trading hour. High values indicate closing-session activity concentration.
vwap_volume_share_last_hour.derivation: Sum volume where minute >= 140000 and <= 150000, divided by total daily volume.

vwap_volume_share_first_hour.description: Fraction of day's total volume traded in the first trading hour. High values = morning-heavy trading (retail/overnight-news driven).
vwap_volume_share_first_hour.derivation: Sum volume where minute >= 93000 and <= 103000, divided by total daily volume.

flow_imbalance.description: Net order flow proxy. Positive = net buying pressure, negative = net selling pressure. Uses bar-level close position as buy/sell proxy.
flow_imbalance.derivation: signed_volume_i = ((close_i − low_i) / (high_i − low_i) − 0.5) × 2 × volume_i. Clamped to [-volume_i, +volume_i]. flow_imbalance = sum(signed_volume) / sum(volume).

flow_imbalance_last_hour.description: Order flow imbalance in the last trading hour. Positive = late-session buying (institutional positioning for next day).
flow_imbalance_last_hour.derivation: Same as flow_imbalance but restricted to bars where minute >= 140000 and <= 150000.

flow_imbalance_first_hour.description: Order flow imbalance in the first trading hour. Reflects overnight news absorption and opening-auction follow-through.
flow_imbalance_first_hour.derivation: Same as flow_imbalance but restricted to bars where minute >= 93000 and <= 103000.

flow_persistence.description: Lag-1 autocorrelation of signed volume across 5-min bars. High persistence = trending order flow (informed), low/negative = mean-reverting flow (noise).
flow_persistence.derivation: Pearson correlation between signed_volume[0:-1] and signed_volume[1:] across bars within the day.

buy_volume_ratio.formula: Σ volume(close > open) / Σ volume(full day)
buy_volume_ratio.description: Fraction of volume in up-bars (close > open). Simple buy/sell proxy — high values = broad buying, low = broad selling.
buy_volume_ratio.derivation: Sum volume where close_i > open_i, divided by total daily volume.

flow_reversal.description: Sign change in order flow from morning to afternoon. Positive = morning buying flipped to afternoon selling (distribution pattern). Negative = morning selling flipped to afternoon buying (accumulation pattern).
flow_reversal.derivation: Difference between first-hour and last-hour flow imbalance.

open_30m_return.description: Return from open to 30 minutes after open. Captures the initial direction and magnitude of opening-gap follow-through.
open_30m_return.derivation: close_30m = close of last bar where minute <= 100000. open = first bar's open price.

open_60m_return.description: Return from open to 60 minutes after open. Wider window than 30m, captures more of the morning session's direction.
open_60m_return.derivation: close_60m = close of last bar where minute <= 103000.

decay_ratio.description: How much of the full day's return is driven by the first 30 minutes. >1 = opening move partially faded during the day. <0 = opening direction reversed (gap fill).
decay_ratio.derivation: day_return = (close_eod − open) / open. decay_ratio = open_30m_return / day_return.

reversal_speed.formula: bar_index where close crosses 50% of open_30m_return
reversal_speed.description: How many bars it takes for the opening move to be half-retraced. Lower = faster reversal. 0 if never halved.
reversal_speed.derivation: Find first bar where: if open_30m_return > 0 and close <= open + 0.5×(close_30m − open); or if < 0 and close >= open + 0.5×(close_30m − open).

gap_fill_ratio.description: Proxy for overnight gap fill ratio. Currently approximated by open_30m_return — a full implementation would use previous day's close.

afternoon_momentum.description: Return from 13:00 afternoon open to market close. Captures post-lunch session direction.
afternoon_momentum.derivation: open_afternoon = open of first bar where minute >= 130000. close_eod = last bar's close.

close_auction_return.description: Return in the last bar of the day. Captures closing-auction price movement.
close_auction_return.derivation: close_penultimate = second-to-last bar's close. close_eod = last bar's close.

morning_volatility.description: Standard deviation of 5-min bar returns in the morning session.
morning_volatility.derivation: bar_return = close_i / close_(i-1) − 1. std over bars where minute <= 113000.

afternoon_volatility.description: Standard deviation of 5-min bar returns in the afternoon session.

vol_curve_skew.description: Ratio of morning to afternoon volatility. >1 = U-shaped (morning more volatile), <1 = L-shaped (afternoon more volatile).
vol_curve_skew.derivation: Simple ratio. Clamped to 1.0 if afternoon_volatility ≈ 0.

jump_count.description: Number of 5-min bars with returns exceeding 3× the intraday standard deviation. Proxies for news-driven price jumps.
jump_count.derivation: Count bars where absolute bar return > 3 × intraday std.

vol_clustering.description: Lag-1 autocorrelation of absolute bar returns. High clustering = volatility begets volatility (trending uncertainty).
vol_clustering.derivation: Pearson correlation between abs(bar_return)[:-1] and abs(bar_return)[1:].

range_ratio.description: Full-day range as a fraction of opening price. Normalized intraday range — high values = volatile day.
range_ratio.derivation: max high and min low across all bars, divided by first bar's open.

trade_size_gini.description: Gini coefficient of trade sizes across 5-min bars. High = concentrated trade sizes (few bars dominate), low = uniform trade sizes.
trade_size_gini.derivation: trade_size_i = amount_i / num_trades_i. Gini = (2Σ(i × sorted_sizes)) / (n × Σsorted_sizes) − (n+1)/n.

price_impact_per_trade.description: Average absolute price change per trade across bars. Higher = more price impact per trade (less liquid).
price_impact_per_trade.derivation: |close_i − close_(i-1)| / num_trades_i, averaged over all bars.

price_impact_tail.description: 95th percentile of price impact per trade. Captures worst-case liquidity episodes during the day.
price_impact_tail.derivation: 95th percentile of the price_impact distribution across bars.

liquidity_gap_count.description: Number of 5-min bars with zero volume or zero trades. Higher = more illiquid, sparsely traded intervals.
liquidity_gap_count.derivation: Simple count over all bars in the day.

spread_proxy.description: Average bar-level spread proxy. (high−low)/close approximates the bid-ask spread as a fraction of price.
spread_proxy.derivation: Mean of (high_i − low_i) / close_i across all bars.

amihud_illiq.description: Amihud (2002) illiquidity measure. Higher = more price impact per unit of turnover (less liquid).
amihud_illiq.derivation: Mean of |bar_return_i| / amount_i across bars. Amihud, Y. (2002). Illiquidity and stock returns. J. Financial Markets.

volume_stability.description: Coefficient of variation of volume across 5-min bars. Lower = more stable (predictable) volume pattern. Higher = erratic, spiky volume.
volume_stability.derivation: Standard deviation / mean of bar volumes.

large_trade_ratio.description: Fraction of total volume in bars with amount > 95th percentile. High = dominated by large trades (institutional).
large_trade_ratio.derivation: P95 = 95th percentile of bar amounts. Sum volume for bars > P95, divide by total volume.

trade_concentration_hhi.description: Herfindahl-Hirschman Index of volume distribution across 5-min bars. High = volume concentrated in few bars. Low = volume evenly distributed.
trade_concentration_hhi.derivation: Sum of squared volume shares across all bars.

block_trade_count.description: Number of 5-min bars with amount exceeding 10× the median bar amount. Identifies block-trade-level bars.
block_trade_count.derivation: Count bars where amount > 10 × median amount across the day.

retail_flow_ratio.description: Fraction of volume in bars with above-median number of trades. More trades per bar = more retail participation (smaller orders).
retail_flow_ratio.derivation: Median num_trades across bars. Sum volume where num_trades > median, divide by total volume.

institutional_participation.description: Inverse of retail flow ratio. Higher = more volume in bars with fewer, larger trades (institutional).

sector_lead_rank.description: Placeholder for sector-level lead-lag computation. Full implementation requires cross-stock correlation within sectors.
sector_lead_rank.derivation: Currently set to 0.5. Future: cross-sectional rank of 1-min return lead over sector peers.

peer_correlation_lag1.description: Placeholder for peer correlation at lag 1. Full implementation requires cross-stock computation.

information_arrival_speed.description: Normalized time to reach 50% of the day's total absolute return. Lower = information arrives early (opening-driven). Higher = information arrives gradually throughout the day.
information_arrival_speed.derivation: Cumulative sum of |bar_return|. Find bar index where cumsum >= 0.5 × total, divide by total bars.

lead_lag_strength.description: Placeholder for maximum cross-correlation with sector ETF at lags ≤ 10 min.

flow_vol_interaction.description: Interaction: order flow direction × volatility persistence. High + clustering = trending informed flow. Low + clustering = choppy noise.
flow_vol_interaction.derivation: Element-wise product of two base features.

vwap_momentum_combo.description: Interaction: above-VWAP close + positive afternoon momentum = sustained buying. Below-VWAP + negative momentum = sustained selling.
vwap_momentum_combo.derivation: Element-wise product of two base features.

liquidity_volatility_ratio.description: Illiquidity normalized by volatility. High = illiquid relative to how much it moves (expensive to trade).
